purpose: prove that a later disclosed direction and its two times were committed before external timestamps
committed_claims: one salted claim for every contiguous token
privacy: the internal selection process and all non-claim fields are outside the public proof
near_time_witness: fixed five-minute Merkle root with Sigstore RFC3161 timestamp and transparency-log inclusion proof
long_term_witness: fixed hourly Merkle root with OpenTimestamps Bitcoin attestation
missing_data: never backdated; a recovered claim enters the external interval in which it was actually observed
